checks_per_sample: saved params regenerate vertices, 308 keypoints and 127 joints
uint16 millimetre depth is the exact declared derivative

root_causes: The initial independent ray used integer (u,v), while pyrender/OpenGL evaluates depth at fragment centre (u+0.5,v+0.5).
The initial ray test accepted both triangle windings although the renderer uses back-face culling.
Outer-mask erosion did not exclude internal z-buffer boundaries such as one body part crossing another.
validator_correction_audit.evidence: On one failing sample, ray offset +0.5 reduced maximum Z residual from about 70.7 mm to 3.64 mm without changing the mesh, depth or 5 mm gate.
corrections: exclude 3x3 depth neighbourhoods whose range is at least 0.03 m
validator_correction_audit.gate_change: NONE; the maximum surface-closure threshold remained 0.005 m
validator_correction_audit.failed_artifacts_policy: The failed first run is preserved on the server and is not an accepted dataset.

observations: All 100 samples contain a complete, non-empty human render with matching depth and mask.
No gross near-plane clipping, left-right reflection, empty body, camera crop failure or broken topology was observed.
Viewpoints span front, side, back and oblique directions.
visual_validation.distribution_limitation: The smoke uses narrow bounded random parameters and is dominated by near-neutral upright body configurations. It does not yet cover realistic prone/contact or the full complex-pose target distribution.

required_before_training: design a realistic pose-source or pose-library strategy rather than scaling this random smoke distribution unchanged
run the identity-disjoint 1000 protocol and obtain 1000/1000 automatic PASS
visually review at least 100 stratified samples including all identities and view extremes
freeze a synthetic-to-real ablation evaluated on held-out public RGB-D and target-domain data

claim_limit: This result proves exact MHR parameter replay and internally consistent synthetic RGB/Z-depth geometry. It does not prove realistic pose coverage, real-scene generalization, bare-back surface accuracy, DMD37 accuracy or medical validity.
